name: paneview-even-first-expand
title: PaneView: even-split first-time expand
description: Fix first-time expand (e.g. Labels next to a large Inspector) showing tiny: when a collapsed pane expands with no persisted size (saved===null), default to an EVEN split across all currently-expanded panes (all siblings' saved reset in-memory, not persisted), instead of keeping siblings at their saved px and giving the new pane the remainder. User adjustments still persist (drag/arrows/dblclick). Applies per all panels (per-panel storage already). Update Q5-A behavior note + spec.
creator: deviousprophet
